xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5054: apps/mobile/ACCEPTANCE.md conflicts every parallel phone PR: mark it merge=union like concerns.md

plan.title: apps/mobile/ACCEPTANCE.md conflicts every parallel phone PR: mark it merge=union like concerns.md
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Every phone-app PR appends its acceptance evidence as a new section at the end of apps/mobile/ACCEPTANCE.md, so any two phone PRs in flight conflict at the end of the file and each pays a conflict-repair round, a re-verify and a re-review. The issue proposed merge=union, but a planning probe showed git's union merge silently interleaves two realistic evidence sections (shared blank lines, `| --- |` table rows and `**Result: PASS.**` lines are emitted once and the rest is split around them) with no conflict markers.
narratives.Proposal: Do not mark ACCEPTANCE.md union. Each new phone issue writes its evidence in its own file, apps/mobile/acceptance/PAN-<n>.md, with screenshots beside it as pan-<n>-<step>.png; two PRs that add different files never conflict. ACCEPTANCE.md keeps its existing sections byte-identical and gets a note at the top pointing new evidence at the per-issue files. .gitattributes gets a comment explaining why the file is deliberately not union. A Vitest test guards that the evidence files carry no merge driver and shows two branches adding per-issue files merge cleanly. docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md, apps/mobile/README.md and the codebase-map conventions.md state the convention.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Marking apps/mobile/ACCEPTANCE.md or any markdown file merge=union
- Adding any new merge= attribute line to .gitattributes
- Moving, rewriting or reformatting the existing sections of apps/mobile/ACCEPTANCE.md (line 7 onward stays byte-identical)
- An index file listing the per-issue evidence files
- A lint or test that refuses new sections in apps/mobile/ACCEPTANCE.md
- Changing the open PRs #5051 (PAN-4840) and #5049 (PAN-5046) or the PRDs/specs of other phone issues
- A test that asserts git's union interleaving behavior
- PAN-4616 (whether GitHub's mergeable honors merge=union)

autoDecisions.summary: Rejected the issue's proposed merge=union for apps/mobile/ACCEPTANCE.md; switched to one evidence file per issue (apps/mobile/acceptance/PAN-<n>.md).
autoDecisions.rationale: Probe in a temp repo seeded with the real file's last 20 lines: two branches each appended a realistic evidence section; with `A.md merge=union`, both `git merge-tree --write-tree` and `git merge` exited 0 but produced `## PAN-111 ...` directly followed by `## PAN-222 ...`, PAN-111 table rows running into PAN-222 bullets, and a final table mixing both issues' rows. Silent interleaving is worse than a visible conflict. Separate files remove the conflict entirely and avoid the PAN-4616 GitHub question. The issue body is a proposed fix, not a contradictory authoritative requirement, so this is a defensible default rather than a halt.

autoDecisions.summary: Existing ACCEPTANCE.md sections stay in place; only a top note is added.
autoDecisions.rationale: Rewriting the file would conflict with the two open PRs (#5051, #5049) that append to it, and later PRDs cite its sections by heading.

autoDecisions.summary: No shared index of per-issue evidence files and no enforcement lint.
autoDecisions.rationale: A shared index recreates the append hot spot; a lint would turn the two open PRs' CI red after this lands. The note plus docs steer new plans; a miss costs one conflict repair, as today.

autoDecisions.summary: Per-issue file naming: apps/mobile/acceptance/PAN-<n>.md with screenshots pan-<n>-<step>.png in the same folder.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the .pan/drafts/PAN-<n>.md naming, keeps relative screenshot links short, and nothing in code or CI globs apps/mobile/acceptance/ (git grep found only a comment).

autoDecisions.summary: The test lives in a new tests/unit/mobile/acceptance-evidence-merge.test.ts instead of extending the PAN-4614 merge-door test.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PAN-4614 test exercises a union-marked file through the merge door; with no union attribute there is nothing for the door to resolve, so the check-attr + merge-tree pattern of tests/unit/scripts/frontend-test-subset-merge.test.ts is the right template.

Test that phone evidence files carry no merge driver and per-issue files merge cleanly

expected_outputs: vitest reports 1 file and 2 tests passed

narrative.Action: Create tests/unit/mobile/acceptance-evidence-merge.test.ts modeled on tests/unit/scripts/frontend-test-subset-merge.test.ts (execFileSync git, mkdtempSync temp repos, git merge-tree --write-tree, git cat-file -p <tree>:<path>; rmSync temp dirs in afterEach). Test 1 runs `git check-attr merge -- apps/mobile/ACCEPTANCE.md apps/mobile/acceptance/PAN-1.md` at the repo root and expects both lines to end in `merge: unspecified`. Test 2 builds a temp repo whose base commit has the real repo's .gitattributes (readFileSync) and a small apps/mobile/ACCEPTANCE.md; branch x adds apps/mobile/acceptance/PAN-111.md and branch y adds apps/mobile/acceptance/PAN-222.md, each body containing a `| --- | --- | --- | --- |` row and `**Result: PASS.**`; it expects merge-tree to exit 0 and each file at the merged tree to equal what its branch wrote. No skipIf, no .only, no reading of .ts source text, no timers.

`npx vitest run tests/unit/mobile/acceptance-evidence-merge.test.ts` passes 2 tests and `bash scripts/lint-source-introspection.sh` exits 0
